2. INV-00038 (Ishaan Patel, issued 2026-09-03)
3. INV-00238 (Aditya Shah, issued 2026-09-06)

The payment was captured on 2026-09-13. While the date matches INV-00189's issue date, the payment could potentially match either of the other two invoices. However, since the pattern is "partial_payment" and the amounts match exactly, this isn't really a partial payment - it's a complete payment of one invoice.
